cond_0001.intro: The Senior Manufacturing Engineer plays a critical role in optimizing our manufacturing processes, ensuring product quality while driving efficiency and reducing waste in the operation. This position requires a strong background in manufacturing with significant experience implementing Lean Manufacturing principles and the leadership skills to lead a team of process engineers in achieving our process improvement goals. Experience in automotive manufacturing is not mandatory, but highly desirable.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve overall efficiency to meet production targets. Analyze direct and indirect workflows to improve the quality and efficiency of manufacturing and other processes. Use Lean Manufacturing tools such as value stream mapping, 5S, poka-yoke, and others to drive improvements.
Team Leadership: Supervise and mentor a team of process engineers, providing guidance and support to drive continuous improvement.
Quality Assurance: Collaborate with Quality Assurance teams to implement quality control measures and ensure that all vehicles meet or exceed established quality standards.
Cost Management: Analyze production costs and implement cost-effective measures without compromising quality and safety. Analyze labor hour trends by activity, station, and product configuration and propose actions to improve labor utilization.
Risk Mitigation: Drive PFMEAs to identify risks and take appropriate corrective action.
New Technology Integration: Evaluate and introduce new manufacturing technologies and tools to improve productivity and product quality. Work with finance, product development and component suppliers to research and prepare new equipment analysis to ensure the company is making proper in- and out-sourcing decisions.
Supplier Collaboration: Work closely with Supply Chain team to ensure timely delivery of components and materials, while maintaining cost-effectiveness and quality standards.
Safety and Compliance: Maintain a safe working environment, ensuring that all manufacturing processes adhere to safety regulations and compliance standards.
Data Analysis: Utilize data analysis tools and techniques to monitor and analyze key performance indicators, identifying areas for improvement.
Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging team members to suggest and implement innovative solutions. Work with product development to implement standardized design criteria across all product lines to ensure that new products are designed considering manufacturing efficiency and quality.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of seven years of experience in manufacturing and/or process engineering in a manufacturing environment.
Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Preferred Requirements
Master's degree in a related field.
Familiarity with CAD software and manufacturing simulation tools.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0001.values: We value creating outcomes that are useful, fair, and mindful of the people they affect. We aim to approach our work with responsibility and respect.

cond_0043.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team at [Location masked], where we build new Ford-licensed reproduction 1965-68 Mustang and Shelby GT automobiles.
This role focuses on optimizing manufacturing processes, maintaining product quality, and reducing waste. It requires a solid background in manufacturing, hands-on experience with Lean Manufacturing principles, and the ability to lead a team of process engineers toward process improvement goals. Automotive manufacturing experience is not required but is a plus.
cond_0043.responsibilities:
Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to improve manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and meet production targets. Analyze direct and indirect workflows to improve quality and efficiency. Apply Lean Manufacturing tools such as value stream mapping, 5S, and poka-yoke to support improvements.
Team Leadership: Supervise and mentor a team of process engineers, providing guidance to support continuous improvement goals.
Quality Assurance: Coordinate with Quality Assurance teams on quality control measures to ensure all vehicles meet established standards.
Cost Management: Analyze production costs and implement cost-effective measures without compromising quality or safety. Review labor hour trends by activity, station, and product configuration and propose actions to improve labor utilization.
Risk Mitigation: Conduct PFMEAs to identify risks and take appropriate corrective action.
New Technology Integration: Evaluate and introduce manufacturing technologies and tools to improve productivity and product quality. Coordinate with finance, product development, and component suppliers to research and prepare equipment analyses supporting in- and out-sourcing decisions.
Supplier Coordination: Work with the Supply Chain team to support timely delivery of components and materials while maintaining cost and quality standards.
Safety and Compliance: Maintain a safe working environment and ensure all manufacturing processes adhere to safety regulations and compliance standards.
Data Analysis: Use data analysis tools to monitor key performance indicators and identify areas for improvement.
Continuous Improvement: Support a culture of continuous improvement by guiding team members in developing and implementing practical solutions. Coordinate with product development to apply standardized design criteria across product lines, ensuring new products account for manufacturing efficiency and quality.

cond_0371.intro: The Senior Manufacturing Engineer plays a critical role in optimizing our manufacturing processes, ensuring product quality while driving efficiency and reducing waste in the operation. This position requires a strong background in manufacturing with significant experience implementing Lean Manufacturing principles and the leadership skills to lead a team of process engineers in achieving our process improvement goals. Experience in automotive manufacturing is not mandatory, but highly desirable.
cond_0371.responsibilities: Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve overall efficiency to meet production targets. Analyze direct and indirect workflows to improve the quality and efficiency of manufacturing and other processes. Use Lean Manufacturing tools such as value stream mapping, 5S, poka-yoke, and others to drive improvements. Team Leadership: Supervise and mentor a team of process engineers, providing guidance and support to drive continuous improvement. Quality Assurance: Collaborate with Quality Assurance teams to implement quality control measures and ensure that all vehicles meet or exceed established quality standards. Cost Management: Analyze production costs and implement cost-effective measures without compromising quality and safety. Analyze labor hour trends by activity, station, and product configuration and propose actions to improve labor utilization. Risk Mitigation: Drive PFMEAs to identify risks and take appropriate corrective action. New Technology Integration: Evaluate and introduce new manufacturing technologies and tools to improve productivity and product quality. Work with finance, product development and component suppliers to research and prepare new equipment analysis to ensure the company is making proper in- and out-sourcing decisions. Supplier Collaboration: Work closely with Supply Chain team to ensure timely delivery of components and materials, while maintaining cost-effectiveness and quality standards. Safety and Compliance: Maintain a safe working environment, ensuring that all manufacturing processes adhere to safety regulations and compliance standards. Data Analysis: Utilize data analysis tools and techniques to monitor and analyze key performance indicators, identifying areas for improvement. Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging team members to suggest and implement innovative solutions. Work with product development to implement standardized design criteria across all product lines to ensure that new products are designed considering manufacturing efficiency and quality.

cond_0473.intro: We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team at [Location masked], where we build new Ford-licensed reproduction 1965-68 Mustang and Shelby GT automobiles. The Senior Manufacturing Engineer plays a critical role in optimizing our manufacturing processes, ensuring product quality while driving efficiency and reducing waste in the operation. This position requires a strong background in manufacturing with significant experience implementing Lean Manufacturing principles and the leadership skills to lead a team of process engineers in achieving our process improvement goals. Experience in automotive manufacturing is not mandatory, but highly desirable. Most people become stronger in this kind of manufacturing and process engineering work over time as they build experience and learn from feedback.
cond_0473.responsibilities:
Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve overall efficiency to meet production targets. Analyze direct and indirect workflows to improve the quality and efficiency of manufacturing and other processes. Use Lean Manufacturing tools such as value stream mapping, 5S, poka-yoke, and others to drive improvements.
Team Leadership: Supervise and mentor a team of process engineers, providing guidance and support to drive continuous improvement.
Quality Assurance: Collaborate with Quality Assurance teams to implement quality control measures and ensure that all vehicles meet or exceed established quality standards.
Cost Management: Analyze production costs and implement cost-effective measures without compromising quality and safety. Analyze labor hour trends by activity, station, and product configuration and propose actions to improve labor utilization.
Risk Mitigation: Drive PFMEAs to identify risks and take appropriate corrective action.
New Technology Integration: Evaluate and introduce new manufacturing technologies and tools to improve productivity and product quality. Work with finance, product development and component suppliers to research and prepare new equipment analysis to ensure the company is making proper in- and out-sourcing decisions.
Supplier Collaboration: Work closely with Supply Chain team to ensure timely delivery of components and materials, while maintaining cost-effectiveness and quality standards.
Safety and Compliance: Maintain a safe working environment, ensuring that all manufacturing processes adhere to safety regulations and compliance standards.
Data Analysis: Utilize data analysis tools and techniques to monitor and analyze key performance indicators, identifying areas for improvement.
Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging team members to suggest and implement innovative solutions. Work with product development to implement standardized design criteria across all product lines to ensure that new products are designed considering manufacturing efficiency and quality.

cond_0648.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Manufacturing Engineer to join our team at [Location masked], where we build new Ford-licensed reproduction 1965-68 Mustang and Shelby GT automobiles.
The Senior Manufacturing Engineer works closely with process engineers and cross-functional teams to optimize manufacturing processes, support product quality, and help reduce waste across the operation. This position requires a strong background in manufacturing with significant experience implementing Lean Manufacturing principles and the ability to guide a team of process engineers toward shared process improvement goals. Experience in automotive manufacturing is not mandatory, but highly desirable.
cond_0648.responsibilities:
Process Optimization: Work with the team to identify opportunities to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve overall efficiency to meet production targets. Coordinate analysis of direct and indirect workflows to improve the quality and efficiency of manufacturing and other processes. Use Lean Manufacturing tools such as value stream mapping, 5S, poka-yoke, and others to support improvements.
Team Leadership: Supervise and mentor a team of process engineers, providing guidance and support to advance continuous improvement together.
Quality Assurance: Collaborate with Quality Assurance teams to implement quality control measures and help ensure that all vehicles meet or exceed established quality standards.
Cost Management: Work with relevant stakeholders to analyze production costs and implement cost-effective measures without compromising quality and safety. Coordinate analysis of labor hour trends by activity, station, and product configuration and propose actions to improve labor utilization.
Risk Mitigation: Facilitate PFMEAs with the team to identify risks and support appropriate corrective action.
New Technology Integration: Evaluate and introduce new manufacturing technologies and tools in coordination with the team to improve productivity and product quality. Work with finance, product development, and component suppliers to research and prepare new equipment analysis to help ensure the company is making sound in- and out-sourcing decisions.
Supplier Collaboration: Work closely with the Supply Chain team to help ensure timely delivery of components and materials, while maintaining cost-effectiveness and quality standards.
Safety and Compliance: Support a safe working environment, helping ensure that all manufacturing processes adhere to safety regulations and compliance standards.
Data Analysis: Use data analysis tools and techniques to monitor and analyze key performance indicators together with the team, identifying areas for improvement.
Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging team members to suggest and implement innovative solutions. Coordinate with product development to implement standardized design criteria across all product lines to help ensure that new products are designed with manufacturing efficiency and quality in mind.
